name: blawx-fixpoint-harness-deps
description: Optional dependencies for etc/blawx-fixpoint-harness.mjs. Deliberately NOT in the repo's package.json (BLAWX-EXPORT-SPEC R13: optional-when-present, never a build dependency; the repo lockfile is drifted, so a new entry would block CI) and outside the root workspaces globs (ts-apps/*, ts-shared/*), so npm never hoists it. Install with: npm install --prefix etc/blawx-fixpoint-harness.deps
